issues.where: data/public/calls/msca-pf-gf/call.yaml / call.md, ME5: "Provide career-development, dissemination, exploitation and communication measures; justify intellectual-property management where relevant."; ME7: "Establish qualifying nationality or long-term residence ... and identify the outgoing partner’s commitment status."; ME8: "For Euratom research, the beneficiary and the researcher must meet ..."
issues.problem: ME5 combines five separately assessable requirements in one scored item. ME7 additionally combines personal eligibility and an unrelated institutional commitment. The Euratom item is pure eligibility, not a narrative treatment. These constructions violate the checklist’s atomic-item and eligibility-routing rules and can change partial/no judgements and call-component weighting.

Move the Euratom eligibility item to the eligibility prose without removing the rule. Move the nationality/residence part of ME7 to eligibility and retain the atomic narrative item "Identify the outgoing partner and the status of its fellowship-hosting commitment." Replace ME2 with separate items: "Identify the beneficiary and responsible supervisors"; "Describe access to the required hosting resources"; "Specify individual training and supervision arrangements"; "Define reciprocal knowledge-transfer activities". Replace ME4 with: "Present a timed work plan with responsibilities and effort, including all host stays and secondments"; "Provide a Gantt chart locating milestones and deliverables"; "Identify implementation risks and specific mitigations". Use unique item IDs and identical text in both files. Preserve the eligibility-history narrative requested by ME1, since it provides the visible location for the mobility trap.
